trainerShare.title: Share with the trainer
trainerShare.consentText: Choose which measurements to share with Massimo Filippi, trainer of the Master HRV, to be used as case studies during the course. Your clients will not be identifiable: Massimo will only see initials, year of birth, sex and the measurement data. He will not see full names, contact details, notes or health information. Sharing expires automatically after 90 days and you can revoke it at any time from this page. By sharing a client's data you confirm that you have informed them and have their consent to this educational use.
trainerShare.noCode: measurements only, no code (name, year of birth and sex are missing)

trainerShare.noClients: You have no clients yet: you can only share your own measurements.
trainerShare.confirmLabel: I confirm that I have read the text above and, for the selected clients, that I have informed them and have their consent to this educational use.

trainerShare.footnote: The trainer only sees the case code and the measurement data. Every read is logged.
